Fixed Salary \+ UNLIMITED Incentives \| Freshers \& Experienced Welcome \| Fast Career Growth

Are you a fresher looking for your first opportunity?

Or are you already in sales and looking for a role where your effort can increase your earnings?

Join our team as a Business Development Executive and build valuable skills in communication, sales, customer handling, and business development.

We’re looking for confident, energetic, and target\-driven people who are ready to learn, perform, and grow.

Your Effort. Your Performance. Your Incentives.

Your fixed salary gives you stability — and our uncapped incentive structure gives you the opportunity to earn more based on your performance.

The better you perform, the more you can earn.

WHAT YOU GET! Fixed Monthly Salary

Earn ₹25000/month, depending on your skills and experience.

Uncapped Incentives

Achieve your sales goals and earn attractive performance\-based incentives.

Extra Language Bonus

Know Telugu, Malayalam, or Hindi?

Get an additional ₹1,000 bonus.

If you have confidence, good communication skills, and the willingness to learn, you can apply.

Develop real\-world skills in:

Sales \& Negotiation

Customer Communication

Lead Conversion

Relationship Building

Business Development

Connect with potential customers through inbound and outbound calls.

Follow up with interested customers.

Build positive relationships with customers.

Maintain accurate customer and follow\-up records.

Provide a professional and positive customer experience.

**WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

You could be a great fit if you are:

✔ A fresher or have 0–2 years of experience

✔ Comfortable communicating in Tamil

✔ Able to communicate in basic/good English

Your first job doesn't need to be your last job.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to gain experience, improve your communication skills, earn incentives, and build a career in sales, this is your chance to get started.

**WHY WAIT?**

If you have the confidence to communicate, the willingness to learn, and the drive to achieve, we want to meet you!

jobs.title: Telesales Executive
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an enthusiastic and target\-oriented **Telesales Executive** to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for contacting potential customers, explaining our products/services, generating leads, and converting them into sales.

Key Responsibilities

* Make outbound calls to prospective customers.
* Explain company products/services and answer customer queries.
* Generate and follow up on leads through calls.
* Maintain good relationships with existing and potential customers.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, and sales activities.
* Follow up with customers regularly to close sales.
* Coordinate with the sales team for successful lead conversion.

Requirements

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office and computer applications.
* Strong convincing and negotiation skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to achieve targets.
* Ability to handle customer queries professionally.
* Freshers can also apply.

Skills

* Telecalling \& Customer Handling
* Sales \& Negotiation
* Lead Generation
* Follow\-up Skills
* Tamil \& English language proficiency

Pay: Up to ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: HR Trainee
jobs.description:
**Company:** Otomatiks  
**Location:** Vellore, Tamil Nadu  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reports To:** HR Manager / HR Head

About the Role

We are looking for a **motivated and organized HR Trainee** to join our team in Vellore. The candidate will receive practical exposure to various areas of Human Resources, including recruitment, employee coordination, attendance, documentation, onboarding, and day\-to\-day HR administration.

This role is ideal for a candidate who is looking to build a career in Human Resources and is willing to learn, take responsibility, and work closely with employees and management.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Recruitment \& Hiring**

* Assist in sourcing candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, and other channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Coordinate interview schedules with candidates and hiring managers.
* Communicate with candidates regarding interview schedules, selection, and joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate databases.
* Assist with joining and onboarding processes.

**2\. Employee Coordination**

* Act as a point of contact for employees regarding routine HR\-related queries.
* Coordinate with employees and reporting managers for HR requirements.
* Assist in addressing employee concerns and escalating issues to the HR Manager when required.
* Support employee engagement activities and internal communication.

**3\. HR Administration**

* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Assist with preparation and collection of joining documents.
* Maintain attendance, leave, permission, and other HR records.
* Assist in maintaining employee files and HR trackers.
* Support the HR team in preparing letters, notices, and other HR documents.

**4\. Onboarding \& Offboarding**

* Coordinate employee joining formalities.
* Ensure required documents are collected and properly maintained.
* Conduct or assist with HR induction for new employees.
* Assist with resignation, exit formalities, and employee offboarding documentation.

**5\. HR Policies \& Compliance**

* Assist in communicating HR policies and procedures to employees.
* Ensure employees follow established HR processes.
* Support the HR team in maintaining proper documentation and records.
* Assist with implementation of HR initiatives and internal policies.

**6\. General HR Support**

* Prepare HR reports and trackers as required.
* Assist the HR Manager with daily HR activities.
* Coordinate with different departments for manpower and employee\-related requirements.
* Handle HR information with confidentiality and professionalism.
* Perform other HR\-related duties assigned by the Management or HR Manager.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field**.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with **0–1 year of HR experience** will be preferred.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace.
* Good organizational and documentation skills.
* Ability to communicate professionally with employees and candidates.
* Willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee information.

Key Skills

* Recruitment \& Candidate Coordination
* Employee Communication
* HR Documentation
* Attendance \& Leave Management
* MS Excel / Google Sheets
* Communication Skills
* Problem Solving
* Time Management
* Team Coordination
* Attention to Detail

What We Offer

* Hands\-on exposure to various HR functions.
* Opportunity to work closely with the HR and Management team.
* Practical experience in recruitment and HR operations.
* Learning and career growth opportunities.
* Professional and dynamic work environment.

Salary

**₹12,000 – ₹15,000 per month**, depending on skills, qualification, and experience.

Preferred Candidate

A proactive, responsible, and people\-oriented individual who is genuinely interested in building a career in Human Resources and is comfortable handling both **people coordination and administrative responsibilities**.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Education:

* Master's (Required)

* English (Required)
